location.en: Kai's room, on the phone with Leo's host family
location.zh: 凱的房間，打電話到里歐的寄宿家庭

goal.en: Call Leo's home and leave a message about his wallet.
goal.zh: 打電話到里歐家，留言告訴他錢包的事。

background: small apartment bedroom in the evening, a desk by the window with a glowing desk lamp, a cup of tea, a brown leather wallet on the desk, city lights outside

intro.en: The day after Mia's party, you find Leo's wallet under a sofa cushion. His phone is off.
intro.zh: 米亞生日派對的隔天，你在沙發坐墊下找到里歐的錢包，但他的手機沒開。

intro.en: You find his host family's home number and make the call.
intro.zh: 你找到他寄宿家庭的電話號碼，撥了出去。

choices.en: Hi, this is Kai speaking. Is Leo there?
choices.zh: 您好，我是凱。請問里歐在嗎？
choices.tip: 電話裡自我介紹用 This is...，找人用 Is ... there?。

choices.en: Hello, I am Kai. I want to find Leo.
choices.zh: 您好，我是凱，我要找里歐。

lines.en: Find him? Oh dear, is Leo lost?
lines.zh: 找他？天啊，里歐走丟了嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Moore almost calls the police before you can explain. Leo was at the gym the whole time.
story.zh: 你還來不及解釋，摩爾太太就差點報警了。其實里歐一直都在健身房。

fail.why: 「我要找某人」直翻成 I want to find... 聽起來像那個人失蹤了。電話裡說 Is Leo there? 或 May I speak to Leo?。

choices.en: Hello? Who's this? I need Leo.
choices.zh: 喂？你哪位？叫里歐聽電話。

lines.en: Excuse me? You called this house. Who are YOU?
lines.zh: 什麼？是你打來我家的耶，你又是誰？

story.en: Mrs. Moore hangs up. Later, she tells Leo that a very rude person called.
story.zh: 摩爾太太掛了電話，之後跟里歐說有個很沒禮貌的人打來。

fail.why: 打電話的人應該先報上自己的名字，反問對方是誰很不禮貌。先說 Hi, this is Kai.，再說要找誰。

lines.en: Oh, hi Kai! Leo talks about you all the time. I'm sorry, he's at the gym right now.
lines.zh: 喔，嗨，凱！里歐常常提到你。不好意思，他現在在健身房。

choices.en: Oh, I see. Can I leave a message?
choices.zh: 喔，這樣啊。我可以留言嗎？
choices.tip: 要找的人不在時，用 Can I leave a message? 請對方轉達。

choices.en: Oh. When he come back? He can call me?
choices.zh: 喔，他什麼時候回來？他可以打給我嗎？

lines.en: When he... come back? Do you mean when will he be back?
lines.zh: 他什麼……回來？你是說他什麼時候會回來嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Moore thinks Leo already came back and checks every room in the house. He's still at the gym.
story.zh: 摩爾太太以為里歐已經回來了，把家裡每個房間都找了一遍。他還在健身房。

fail.why: 問句要有助動詞：When will he be back? Can he call me?。少了 will 和 can 的位置調換，對方很難聽懂你在問什麼。

choices.en: Oh no! Again? Leo is always out.
choices.zh: 不會吧！又不在？里歐老是不在家。

lines.en: Well, he's allowed to go to the gym, dear.
lines.zh: 嗯，他去健身房也很正常啊。

story.en: Mrs. Moore tells Leo that you complained about him. Leo is very confused.
story.zh: 摩爾太太跟里歐說你在抱怨他，里歐一頭霧水。

fail.why: 對朋友的家人抱怨朋友「老是不在」，聽起來像在批評他。說 Oh, I see. 再請對方幫忙轉達就好。

lines.en: Of course. Let me grab a pen... Okay, go ahead.
lines.zh: 當然好。我拿一下筆……好，請說。

choices.en: Could you tell him I have his wallet?
choices.zh: 可以請您告訴他，他的錢包在我這裡嗎？
choices.tip: Could you tell him...? 是請對方轉達留言的禮貌說法。

choices.en: Please tell him his money bag is in my home.
choices.zh: 請告訴他，他的錢包在我家。

lines.en: His money bag? A whole bag of money?

story.en: Leo hears "a bag of money" and thinks he won a prize. He's a little sad when you hand him his old wallet.
story.zh: 里歐聽到「一袋錢」，以為自己中獎了。你把他的舊錢包交給他時，他有點失落。

fail.why: 「錢包」英文是 wallet，女用長夾或手提包可以說 purse。money bag 聽起來像一袋現金。

choices.en: Go where? I'm at home now.

lines.en: No, no. I mean, go ahead and tell me the message.
lines.zh: 不是啦，我是說，請你說要留什麼話。

story.en: You and Mrs. Moore spend two minutes figuring out who is going where. Nobody is going anywhere.
story.zh: 你和摩爾太太花了兩分鐘搞清楚誰要去哪裡。結果誰都沒有要去哪。

fail.why: 電話裡的 Go ahead. 意思是「請說」，不是叫你去哪裡。聽到就可以直接說你的留言。

lines.en: His wallet! Oh, he'll be so relieved. Does he have your number?
lines.zh: 他的錢包！喔，他一定會鬆一口氣。他有你的電話嗎？

choices.en: Yes, he does. Thank you so much!
choices.zh: 有的，他有。真的很謝謝您！
choices.tip: 對方幫你轉達留言，結尾用 Thank you so much! 道謝。

story.en: Mrs. Moore gives Leo the message, then adds, "Your friend is very... efficient."
story.zh: 摩爾太太轉達了留言，又補了一句：「你朋友講話……很有效率。」

fail.why: 對方幫你記留言，結尾只說 That's all. Bye-bye. 太突然。記得先道謝：Thank you so much!

choices.en: Yes. Sorry to bother you. Very sorry!
choices.zh: 有。不好意思打擾了，真的很抱歉！

lines.en: Sorry? But you're helping Leo! Did something else happen?
lines.zh: 抱歉？可是你是在幫里歐啊！還發生了什麼事嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Moore worries that you broke something at the party. She asks Leo about it three times.
story.zh: 摩爾太太擔心你在派對上弄壞了什麼，問了里歐三次。

fail.why: 台灣習慣說「不好意思，打擾了」，但英文一直道歉會讓對方以為你做錯事。對方幫了忙，說 Thank you! 比 Sorry 更恰當。

lines.en: You're very welcome, Kai. I'll tell him the minute he gets home.
lines.zh: 不客氣，凱。他一回家我就馬上告訴他。

lines.en: An hour later, your phone buzzes. It's Leo: "YOU'RE A LIFESAVER!"
lines.zh: 一個小時後，你的手機響了，是里歐傳來的：「你是我的救命恩人！」

story.en: Leo picks up his wallet the next morning and buys you a coffee to say thanks.
story.zh: 里歐隔天早上來拿錢包，還請你喝咖啡道謝。

notes.explain: 電話裡自我介紹用 This is...，不說 I am...。對方看不到你，所以先報名字再說來意。

example.en: Hi, this is Kai from the language school.
example.zh: 您好，我是語言學校的凱。

notes.explain: 打電話找人最常用的說法，更正式可以說 May I speak to Leo?。不要說 I want to find Leo.，聽起來像人失蹤了。

example.en: Hi, may I speak to Ms. Chen, please?

notes.explain: 要找的人不在時使用。接著用 Could you tell him/her...? 說出留言內容。

example.en: Could you tell her I called?
example.zh: 可以請您告訴她我打過電話嗎？

notes.explain: 電話或對話中的 Go ahead. 是「請說、請繼續」，不是叫你去哪裡。聽到就直接開始講。

example.en: Can I ask you something? / Sure, go ahead.
example.zh: 我可以問你一件事嗎？／當然，請說。

notes.explain: 中文常說「不好意思打擾了」，但英文道歉太多會讓人以為出了問題。對方幫忙時，用 Thank you so much! 表達感激。
